releaseNotes:
Feature: Telegram bridge watchdog auto-reconnects when the poll loop stalls (no full app restart)
Feature: Telegram commands (Preview/Deploy/Model/…) no longer block long-poll — handlers run in parallel + outbound send queue
Fix: Real HTTP timeouts on Telegram API calls (no infinite hang after VPN/network blips)
Fix: Deploy Preview times out instead of freezing the bot
Fix: Cursor model list/search capped so a stuck CLI cannot freeze Telegram
Fix: Clearer status when the bridge restarts or a command fails
